what: the first dig stalls ~0.6 s (via a real click; not when triggered directly), and the game runs ~25 fps in a 1920x2100 window on the RTX 2060
why: measured: rendering on the RTX 2060 while the monitor is on the RTX 5070 Ti copies every frame across PCIe (cost grows with the window); on the display GPU: 60 fps locked, 2.3 ms GPU, no first-dig stall. Not a game problem; studio-play started playtests on the 2060
fix: studio-play runs the game on the display GPU (falls back to the 2060 only when the display GPU is full); tests/perf.gd; board_view per-frame caching

guard.ref: bin/studio-play: display GPU detection (sysfs connector -> PCI bus -> nvidia-smi index); skill: measure performance on the display GPU, not via the broker's Godot GPU
